groups.title: Examples
groups.description: Editable example drawings for circuits, network layouts, embedded boards, home energy, audio, laboratory setups and motion control. Select an example to read its explanation, then choose **Open drawing** to edit a copy.

examples.title: Transistor amplifier
examples.description: A transistor amplifier schematic from the original TinyCAD examples, drawn by Matt Pyne. Open the drawing to explore its components and connections, or use it as a starting point for your own design.

examples.title: Small office network
examples.description:
A small office network built from the **Network layout** bundled library. All seven device definitions are embedded, so this drawing opens without loading the library.

The four matching 19-inch 1U panels are a router, a 24-port PoE+ switch with four SFP+ cages, a 24-port patch panel, and a blank panel. An ISP fibre terminal, ceiling access point, and five-port desk switch complete the layout.

| Connection | Route |
| --- | --- |
| Internet hand-off | ONT1 LAN1 to RTR1 WAN1 |
| Rack uplink | RTR1 SFP+1 to SW1 SFP+1 |
| Ceiling access point | SW1 port 4 to PP1 port 1 to AP1 PoE/LAN |
| Desk switch | SW1 port 6 to PP1 port 3 to DS1 port 1 |

Short rack patch leads and longer office cable runs meet at the patch-panel sockets. Each socket represents one whole cable connection. Spare ports and the external ISP fibre endpoint are intentionally left open. This is a physical cable plan with no SPICE simulation model; circuit-checker notices about open sockets and wires entering panel outlines are expected.

Choose **Open drawing** to edit a copy. Keep rack devices at their default scale and use a vertical step of **120 drawing units** to stack additional 1U panels. Add more devices from **Standard → Network layout**, and use **Save As** to keep your own plan.
